Senior Backend Engineer building AI-powered manufacturing platform systems for MISUMI Americas

- Build and maintain event-driven, asynchronous systems using Node.js
- Create robust REST and GraphQL APIs for customer-facing and internal tools

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Backend Engineer building scalable AWS and Node.js systems for MISUMI Americas’ AI-powered digital manufacturing platform. Owning APIs, reliability, and AI-assisted development.
Senior Backend Engineer building AI-powered manufacturing platform systems for MISUMI Americas
Role description:
• Design and develop highly available, scalable backend services in AWS
• Build and maintain event-driven, asynchronous systems using Node.js
• Create robust REST and GraphQL APIs for customer-facing and internal tools
• Use AI coding agents from design through implementation and testing while owning correctness
• Write specifications, tests, and repository context for reliable agent-driven development
• Partner with product, frontend, and infrastructure teams to ship business-impacting features
• Contribute to technical design discussions and drive team best practices
• Share AI patterns, tooling, and lessons learned
• Debug production issues and improve system reliability
• Improve code quality through testing, observability, and documentation
Role requirements:
• 5 + years of backend engineering experience
• Strong skills in Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript
• Experience building systems on AWS (SQS, Lambda, EC2, RDS, etc.)
• Solid understanding of distributed systems and event-driven architectures
• Experience designing and maintaining REST or GraphQL APIs
• Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases
• A commitment to writing unit and integration tests
• Knowledge of system design, caching, and security best practices (OWASP Top 10)
• Hands-on experience shipping production code with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agent mode), with clear examples of where you had to step in, correct, or override them
• Strong code review skills, applied just as rigorously to AI-generated changes
• Must be a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder)
• AWS certification, experience with high-scale or business-critical systems, pricing/quoting or numerically sensitive business logic, and agent workflows/custom tools/MCP integrations are nice to have
Benefits:
• Competitive compensation and benefits
• Flexible, West Coast-friendly work environment
• Minimal travel (0–10%)
Tech stack:
AWS, Distributed Systems, EC2, GraphQL, JavaScript, Node.js, NoSQL, SQL, TypeScript
Company sponsorship flag: sponsorsH1B=true.
